properties.name: A session on another machine works the same design, live
properties.statement: Sessions running on a DIFFERENT machine must be able to work the same design at the same time, through the same one server, without exporting, merging or pulling. The third of the three cases: different projects on one machine has always worked; several sessions on one machine works through --http; this is the one where the seats are not on the same box. Because there is no authentication, being reachable off the machine must be a deliberate act — the server answers only for hosts that were named on the command line, and says so when a bind would otherwise fail silently.
